#!/bin/bash
# Pelican installation container: server files persist only under /mnt/server.
set -euo pipefail
export LC_ALL=C

readonly SERVER_DIR=/mnt/server
readonly REPOSITORY=ProjectReclaimer/project-reclaimer-releases
readonly API_BASE="https://api.github.com/repos/${REPOSITORY}"
readonly DOWNLOAD_BASE="https://github.com/${REPOSITORY}/releases/download"
readonly MINIMUM_VERSION=0.9.18

die() {
    printf 'Project Reclaimer installation failed: %s\n' "$*" >&2
    exit 1
}

# Compare canonical numeric version components without shell integer overflow.
version_at_least_minimum() {
    local candidate="${1#v}" minimum="$MINIMUM_VERSION" part
    local -a actual_parts minimum_parts
    candidate="${candidate%%[-+]*}"
    IFS=. read -r -a actual_parts <<< "$candidate"
    IFS=. read -r -a minimum_parts <<< "$minimum"
    for part in 0 1 2; do
        if (( ${#actual_parts[part]} > ${#minimum_parts[part]} )); then
            return 0
        elif (( ${#actual_parts[part]} < ${#minimum_parts[part]} )); then
            return 1
        elif [[ "${actual_parts[part]}" > "${minimum_parts[part]}" ]]; then
            return 0
        elif [[ "${actual_parts[part]}" < "${minimum_parts[part]}" ]]; then
            return 1
        fi
    done
    # A prerelease of the minimum version is older than that stable release.
    [[ "${1#v}" != "$MINIMUM_VERSION-"* ]]
}

validate_version() {
    local version="${1#v}" prerelease identifier version_without_build
    local semver='^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)(-[0-9A-Za-z-]+(\.[0-9A-Za-z-]+)*)?(\+[0-9A-Za-z-]+(\.[0-9A-Za-z-]+)*)?$'
    [[ "$version" =~ $semver ]] || die "Version must be latest or a semantic version such as v${MINIMUM_VERSION}."
    version_without_build="${version%%+*}"
    if [[ "$version_without_build" == *-* ]]; then
        prerelease="${version_without_build#*-}"
        local -a identifiers
        IFS=. read -r -a identifiers <<< "$prerelease"
        for identifier in "${identifiers[@]}"; do
            if [[ "$identifier" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && ${#identifier} -gt 1 && "$identifier" == 0* ]]; then
                die "Numeric semantic-version prerelease identifiers cannot have leading zeros."
            fi
        done
    fi
    version_at_least_minimum "$version" || die "Dedicated-server releases before v${MINIMUM_VERSION} are unsupported."
}

requested_version="${RECLAIMER_VERSION:-v0.9.18}"
if [[ "$requested_version" != latest ]]; then
    validate_version "$requested_version"
    requested_version="v${requested_version#v}"
fi

packages=()
command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1 || packages+=(curl)
command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || packages+=(jq)
[[ -s /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt ]] || packages+=(ca-certificates)
if (( ${#packages[@]} )); then
    command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "The installer requires a Debian-based image with apt-get."
    apt-get update
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends "${packages[@]}"
fi
for required_command in sha256sum mktemp mkdir cp mv rm chmod; do
    command -v "$required_command" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "Missing required installer command: ${required_command}."
done

mkdir -p "$SERVER_DIR"
stage_dir="$(mktemp -d "${SERVER_DIR}/.reclaimer-install.XXXXXX")"
marker_changed=0
committed=0
had_marker=0
cleanup() {
    local status=$?
    trap - EXIT
    if (( status != 0 && marker_changed && ! committed )); then
        if (( had_marker )); then
            mv -fT -- "$stage_dir/previous-version" "$SERVER_DIR/.reclaimer-version" || printf 'Could not restore the previous release-version marker.\n' >&2
        else
            rm -f -- "$SERVER_DIR/.reclaimer-version" || true
        fi
    fi
    if [[ "$stage_dir" == "$SERVER_DIR"/.reclaimer-install.* && -d "$stage_dir" ]]; then
        rm -rf -- "$stage_dir" || true
    fi
    exit "$status"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
trap 'exit 130' INT
trap 'exit 143' TERM

download() {
    curl --fail --show-error --silent --location \
        --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' --tlsv1.2 \
        --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 600 --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 \
        --output "$2" "$1"
}

if [[ "$requested_version" == latest ]]; then
    release_url="$API_BASE/releases/latest"
else
    release_url="$API_BASE/releases/tags/$requested_version"
fi
printf 'Resolving official Project Reclaimer release %s...\n' "$requested_version"
download "$release_url" "$stage_dir/release.json"
release_version="$(jq -er 'select(.draft == false) | .tag_name | select(type == "string" and length > 0)' "$stage_dir/release.json")" || die "GitHub did not return a valid published release."
validate_version "$release_version"
[[ "$release_version" == v* ]] || die "The release tag must use the official v-prefixed naming convention."
if [[ "$requested_version" != latest && "$release_version" != "$requested_version" ]]; then
    die "GitHub returned an unexpected release tag."
fi

asset_name="project-reclaimer-dedicated-${release_version}.exe"
asset_url="$(jq -er --arg name "$asset_name" '[.assets[] | select(.name == $name)] | if length == 1 then .[0].browser_download_url else error("Dedicated executable asset missing or ambiguous") end | select(type == "string")' "$stage_dir/release.json")" || die "The release does not contain exactly one ${asset_name}."
checksum_url="$(jq -er '[.assets[] | select(.name == "SHA256SUMS.txt")] | if length == 1 then .[0].browser_download_url else error("Checksum asset missing or ambiguous") end | select(type == "string")' "$stage_dir/release.json")" || die "The release does not contain exactly one SHA256SUMS.txt."
[[ "$asset_url" == "$DOWNLOAD_BASE/$release_version/$asset_name" ]] || die "The executable URL is outside the official release."
[[ "$checksum_url" == "$DOWNLOAD_BASE/$release_version/SHA256SUMS.txt" ]] || die "The checksum URL is outside the official release."

download "$checksum_url" "$stage_dir/SHA256SUMS.txt"
expected_hash="$(jq -Rrs --arg name "$asset_name" '
    split("\n")
    | map(rtrimstr("\r") | capture("^(?<hash>[A-Fa-f0-9]{64})[ \\t]+\\*?(?<name>.+)$")? | select(.name == $name))
    | if length == 1 then .[0].hash | ascii_downcase else error("Checksum entry missing or ambiguous") end
' "$stage_dir/SHA256SUMS.txt")" || die "No unique valid SHA-256 entry exists for ${asset_name}."

printf 'Downloading and verifying %s...\n' "$asset_name"
download "$asset_url" "$stage_dir/$asset_name"
[[ -s "$stage_dir/$asset_name" ]] || die "The dedicated executable download is empty."
printf '%s  %s\n' "$expected_hash" "$asset_name" > "$stage_dir/expected.sha256"
(cd "$stage_dir" && sha256sum --check --status expected.sha256) || die "The executable failed SHA-256 verification; existing files were preserved."
chmod 0644 "$stage_dir/$asset_name"
printf '%s\n' "$release_version" > "$stage_dir/new-version"

# Commit the version marker first and restore it if the final executable rename
# fails. Both staging files live on the server volume for atomic renames.
if [[ -e "$SERVER_DIR/.reclaimer-version" || -L "$SERVER_DIR/.reclaimer-version" ]]; then
    [[ ! -d "$SERVER_DIR/.reclaimer-version" ]] || die "The release-version marker is a directory."
    cp -p --no-dereference -- "$SERVER_DIR/.reclaimer-version" "$stage_dir/previous-version"
    had_marker=1
fi
mv -fT -- "$stage_dir/new-version" "$SERVER_DIR/.reclaimer-version"
marker_changed=1
mv -fT -- "$stage_dir/$asset_name" "$SERVER_DIR/project-reclaimer.exe"
committed=1
printf 'Installed Project Reclaimer %s. Existing game files and configuration were preserved.\n' "$release_version"

# Files below are embedded by tools/build_egg.py; no external script host is required.
cd "$SERVER_DIR"
mkdir -p game/halo3/maps/info content/Maps content/Images 'content/Game Modes' content/Mods playlists data
cat > 'reclaimer.py' <<'PELICAN_BUNDLE_RECLAIMER_PY'
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Pelican adapter for Project Reclaimer. Requires Python 3.11+ and Wine 10."""

from __future__ import annotations

import copy
import datetime
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import tomllib
from collections.abc import Mapping


READY = "[Pelican] Project Reclaimer is ready"
GENERATED_CONFIG = "dedicated.pelican.toml"


def integer(env: Mapping[str, str], key: str, default: int, low: int, high: int) -> int:
    try:
        value = int(env.get(key, str(default)))
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise ValueError(f"{key} must be an integer") from exc
    if not low <= value <= high:
        raise ValueError(f"{key} must be between {low} and {high}")
    return value


def build_config(source: dict, env: Mapping[str, str]) -> dict:
    """Apply panel controls without changing the user's advanced template."""
    result = copy.deepcopy(source)
    servers = result.get("server", [])
    if not isinstance(servers, list) or len(servers) != 1:
        raise ValueError("dedicated.toml must contain exactly one [[server]]; create another Pelican server for another instance")
    server = servers[0]
    if not isinstance(server, dict):
        raise ValueError("The [[server]] entry must be a table")
    if "SERVER_PORT" not in env:
        raise ValueError("SERVER_PORT is missing; Pelican must supply the primary allocation")
    port = integer(env, "SERVER_PORT", 49176, 1024, 65535)
    master_port = integer(env, "RECLAIMER_MASTER_PORT", 49175, 1024, 65535)
    maximum = integer(env, "RECLAIMER_MAX_PLAYERS", 16, 1, 127)
    name = env.get("RECLAIMER_SERVER_NAME", "Halo 3 - Project Reclaimer")
    if not name.strip() or len(name) > 48 or any(ord(c) < 32 or ord(c) == 127 for c in name):
        raise ValueError("RECLAIMER_SERVER_NAME must be 1-48 characters without control characters")
    password = env.get("RECLAIMER_RCON_PASSWORD", "")
    if password and len(password) < 8:
        raise ValueError("RECLAIMER_RCON_PASSWORD must be empty or at least 8 characters")
    if password and master_port == port:
        raise ValueError("RCON and discovery need different TCP ports; change RECLAIMER_MASTER_PORT")

    # Keep executable updates under Pelican's reinstall control. Windows
    # self-replacement under Wine must not silently change a pinned release.
    result["auto_update"] = False
    result["upnp"] = False
    result["public_address"] = env.get("RECLAIMER_PUBLIC_ADDRESS", "")
    result.setdefault("master", {}).update(enabled=True, port=master_port)
    result.setdefault("rcon", {}).update(password=password, address="0.0.0.0")
    server.update(name=name, port=port, max_players=maximum, enabled=True)
    # RCON uses TCP at the primary game port; do not retain a template's
    # rcon_port/rcon_password that bypasses the panel controls.
    server.pop("rcon_port", None)
    server.pop("rcon_password", None)
    playlist = env.get("RECLAIMER_PLAYLIST", "").strip()
    if "campaign" in server:
        if maximum > 16:
            raise ValueError("Campaign co-op supports at most 16 players")
        if playlist:
            raise ValueError("Clear RECLAIMER_PLAYLIST when using a campaign template")
        for key in ("map", "game", "playlist", "variant", "base_map"):
            server.pop(key, None)
    else:
        for key in ("map", "game", "playlist", "variant", "base_map"):
            server.pop(key, None)
        if playlist:
            server["playlist"] = playlist
        else:
            server["map"] = env.get("RECLAIMER_MAP", "Guardian")
            server["game"] = env.get("RECLAIMER_GAME_MODE", "Slayer")
    return result


def toml_value(value: object) -> str:
    """Serialize TOML values as inline tables, retaining all advanced keys."""
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False).replace("\x7f", r"\u007f")
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "true" if value else "false"
    if isinstance(value, int):
        return str(value)
    if isinstance(value, float):
        if math.isnan(value):
            return "nan"
        if math.isinf(value):
            return "inf" if value > 0 else "-inf"
        return repr(value)
    if isinstance(value, (datetime.datetime, datetime.date, datetime.time)):
        return value.isoformat()
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return "[" + ", ".join(toml_value(item) for item in value) + "]"
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return "{ " + ", ".join(f"{toml_value(key)} = {toml_value(item)}" for key, item in value.items()) + " }"
    raise ValueError(f"Unsupported TOML value: {type(value).__name__}")


def write_config(root: Path, env: Mapping[str, str]) -> Path:
    source = tomllib.loads((root / "dedicated.toml").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
    config = build_config(source, env)
    text = "# Generated by the Pelican adapter; edit dedicated.toml and panel settings.\n"
    text += "\n".join(f"{toml_value(key)} = {toml_value(value)}" for key, value in config.items()) + "\n"
    tomllib.loads(text)  # Reject serialization problems before replacing anything.
    target = root / GENERATED_CONFIG
    pending = target.with_suffix(".toml.new")
    pending.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    pending.chmod(0o600)
    pending.replace(target)
    return target


class Runner:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.active: subprocess.Popen | None = None
        self.stopping = False

    @staticmethod
    def send(process: subprocess.Popen, sig: int) -> None:
        if process.poll() is None:
            try:
                os.killpg(process.pid, sig)
            except ProcessLookupError:
                pass

    def stop(self, _sig: int, _frame: object) -> None:
        self.stopping = True
        if self.active is not None:
            self.send(self.active, signal.SIGINT)

    def command(self, args: list[str]) -> int:
        if self.stopping:
            return 0
        self.active = subprocess.Popen(args, start_new_session=True)
        stopping_since: float | None = None
        while True:
            try:
                result = self.active.wait(timeout=0.2)
                break
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                if self.stopping:
                    now = time.monotonic()
                    if stopping_since is None:
                        stopping_since = now
                    if now - stopping_since > 25:
                        self.send(self.active, signal.SIGKILL)
        self.active = None
        return result

    @staticmethod
    def probe(args: list[str]) -> bool:
        process = subprocess.Popen(args, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, start_new_session=True)
        try:
            return process.wait(timeout=5) == 0
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            Runner.send(process, signal.SIGKILL)
            process.wait()
            return False

    def serve(self, command: list[str], status: list[str]) -> int:
        if self.stopping:
            return 0
        self.active = subprocess.Popen(command, start_new_session=True)
        ready = False
        next_probe = time.monotonic() + 3
        stopping_since: float | None = None
        while self.active.poll() is None:
            now = time.monotonic()
            if self.stopping:
                if stopping_since is None:
                    stopping_since = now
                if now - stopping_since > 25:
                    self.send(self.active, signal.SIGKILL)
            elif not ready and now >= next_probe:
                if self.probe(status) and not self.stopping and self.active.poll() is None:
                    print(READY, flush=True)
                    ready = True
                next_probe = time.monotonic() + 3
            time.sleep(0.2)
        result = self.active.wait()
        self.active = None
        return 0 if self.stopping else (result if result > 0 else 1)


def main() -> int:
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    os.chdir(root)
    if sys.argv[1:] not in ([], ["check"]):
        raise ValueError("Usage: python3 reclaimer.py [check]")
    if not (root / "project-reclaimer.exe").is_file():
        raise ValueError("project-reclaimer.exe is missing; reinstall the server in Pelican")
    config = write_config(root, os.environ)
    wine = shutil.which("wine") or shutil.which("wine64")
    if wine is None:
        raise ValueError("Wine is missing; use the egg's Pelican Wine 10 image on an x86_64 Linux node")
    os.environ["WINEARCH"] = "win64"
    os.environ.setdefault("WINEPREFIX", str(root / ".wine"))
    os.environ["WINEDEBUG"] = "-all"
    os.environ["WINEDLLOVERRIDES"] = "mscoree,mshtml="
    os.environ["RECLAIMER_DEDICATED_ONLY"] = "1"
    os.environ["RECLAIMER_DEDICATED_AUTO_UPDATE"] = "false"
    # The Wine prefix, Forge cache and user data all live in Pelican's
    # persistent volume. Pelican's Wine entrypoint provides the Xvfb display.
    runner = Runner()
    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, runner.stop)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, runner.stop)
    prefix = Path(os.environ["WINEPREFIX"])
    if not (prefix / "system.reg").is_file():
        print("[Pelican] Initializing the persistent 64-bit Wine prefix...", flush=True)
        if runner.command([wine, "wineboot", "--init"]) != 0:
            return 0 if runner.stopping else 1
    if runner.stopping:
        return 0
    if runner.command([wine, "reg", "add", r"HKCU\Software\Wine\Drivers", "/v", "Audio", "/t", "REG_SZ", "/f"]) != 0:
        return 0 if runner.stopping else 1
    command = [wine, str(root / "project-reclaimer.exe"), "dedicated", "--config", str(config)]
    print("[Pelican] Checking Halo 3 files, configuration and allocated ports...", flush=True)
    result = runner.command([*command, "check"])
    if runner.stopping:
        return 0
    if result:
        print("[Pelican] Check failed. Upload your prepared MCC files into game/ and fix the errors above.", flush=True)
        return 1
    if sys.argv[1:] == ["check"]:
        print("[Pelican] Validation passed; the server has not been started.", flush=True)
        return 0
    print("[Pelican] Starting Project Reclaimer; waiting for its status check...", flush=True)
    return runner.serve(command, [*command, "status"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        raise SystemExit(main())
    except (ValueError, OSError) as error:
        print(f"[Pelican] Error: {error}", file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
        raise SystemExit(1)
PELICAN_BUNDLE_RECLAIMER_PY
if [[ ! -e 'dedicated.toml' ]]; then
cat > 'dedicated.toml' <<'PELICAN_BUNDLE_DEDICATED_TOML'

[defaults]

[[server]]

PELICAN_BUNDLE_DEDICATED_TOML
fi
if [[ ! -e 'playlists/slayer.playlist.json' ]]; then
cat > 'playlists/slayer.playlist.json' <<'PELICAN_BUNDLE_PLAYLISTS_SLAYER_PLAYLIST_JSON'

  "version": 2,
  "name": "Pelican Slayer rotation",

    { "map": "The Pit", "game": "Slayer" }
  ]

fi
if [[ ! -e bans.json ]]; then printf '%s\n' '{"players":[],"ips":[]}' > bans.json; fi
chmod 755 reclaimer.py
printf '%s\n' 'Installation complete. Upload your prepared MCC game/ folder, allocate the discovery TCP port, then start.'

variables.name: Project Reclaimer release
variables.description: v0.9.18 or newer, or latest. Change this and reinstall to update; settings and game files are preserved. Players must use the same release. The installer validates the release number.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: Name shown in the server browser (up to 48 characters).

variables.name: Map
variables.description: Map name or content map path. Ignored when a playlist is selected or a campaign is configured in dedicated.toml.

variables.name: Game mode
variables.description: Game type name or custom game path. Ignored with a playlist or campaign.

variables.name: Playlist
variables.description: Optional playlist path relative to the server folder, e.g. playlists/slayer.playlist.json. Empty uses Map and Game mode. Upload every map the playlist needs.

variables.name: Maximum players
variables.description: 1-127 for multiplayer; campaign co-op is limited to 16. Raise CPU and memory for large games.

variables.name: Discovery TCP port
variables.description: Add this port as a secondary Pelican allocation and allow TCP. Each Pelican server on the same IP needs its own discovery allocation. If RCON is enabled it must differ from the game port.

variables.name: Public address
variables.description: Optional public IPv4 address or DNS name. Empty auto-detects the node's public address. Set it explicitly when the node has several public IPs.

variables.name: RCON password
variables.description: Empty disables RCON. Otherwise use at least 8 characters and allow TCP at the primary game port. RCON is unencrypted; restrict access to trusted tools.

variables.name: Virtual display
variables.description: Required virtual display for Wine on a headless node.

variables.name: Steam auto update
variables.description: Disable the Wine image's unrelated SteamCMD updater. Reinstall to update Project Reclaimer.

variables.name: Winetricks packages
variables.description: No additional Winetricks packages are required by the upstream Docker runtime.
